features.uuid: ADAPT: CHAR(36) pragmatic target; preserve IDs
features.jsonb: ADAPT: MySQL JSON; move indexed/query-heavy logic to columns
features.arrays: MOVE_TO_LARAVEL: account_role arrays become policy input sets
features.enums: ADAPT: MySQL enum or constrained varchar; prefer varchar + CHECK for portability
features.expression_indexes: REDESIGN: generated columns or normalized fields
features.generated_columns: DIRECT/ADAPT: stored generated columns syntax differs
features.triggers: ADAPT: retain only immutable audit/invariant triggers; prefer Laravel services
features.views: DIRECT: MySQL views for read models
features.skip_locked: ADAPT/verify version; not currently relied upon
features.advisory_locks: MOVE_TO_LARAVEL: named lock or idempotency row; row locks preferred
features.rls: MOVE_TO_LARAVEL: scoped repositories + policies; DB constraints remain
features.timestamptz: ADAPT: UTC DATETIME(6) + IANA timezone columns
features.interval/date_trunc: ADAPT: DATE_ADD/CONVERT_TZ; Carbon for period boundaries
features.on_conflict: ADAPT: INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
features.returning: ADAPT: insert then select by UUID; avoid relying on RETURNING

minimum_target: MySQL 8.0.34+ (or MariaDB 10.6+ only after compatibility tests); InnoDB required
